content:
Overview

Martin is a city in Žilina Region with a population of 54,168. The cultural center of Slovakia, home to the Slovak National Museum and the Matica slovenská, surrounded by the Malá Fatra mountains with excellent hiking. Housing is more affordable than the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 5a growing zone supports Cool — many vegetables, some fruit trees. A large share of residents hold a bachelor’s degree or higher. Reported crime rates are relatively low.
